source: Original procedural sound design; no external recordings.

scenes.pipe: Water drips, frantic wrench ratchets, then a small repair ding
scenes.constellation: Rising star pings forming the warning constellation
scenes.bugle: Soft brass call and the warning flag unfurling
scenes.thermometer: Descending icy whistle followed by crystalline frost crackles
scenes.folder: Paper rustle, low ominous hum and a violet shimmer
scenes.gear: Mechanical ticks, heating hiss and a settling clunk
scenes.sandwich: Soft bread pop, paper unfolding and a playful report ping
scenes.web: Tiny spider footsteps, web plucks and a ghostly warning trill
scenes.snowglobe: Glass tap, swirling snow and a festive bug-reveal chime
scenes.sunset: Retro synth descent, digital glitches and neon warning chord
scenes.blossoms: Airy petal swishes and delicate blossom chimes
scenes.coin: Spinning gold shimmer and a final warning coin ring
scenes.stamp: Rubber stamp lift, firm desk thump and paper shuffle
scenes.terminal: WarGames terminal radar blips, descending vector whistle and muted impact rumble
